fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-02-17, around 21:55, a transport worker was allegedly waylaid near Vetri Layout Industrial Area and cash of about Rs. 25,000 was taken from the complainant, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-02-17. Arjun Pandian reported the matter orally at Coimbatore North PS; the contact number given was 9000000330. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-38-XX-1024 was seen leaving the area. Karthik Rajan (9000000091), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Madhan Murugan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000216, in connection with the events. A witness, Vignesh Balan, reachable on 9000000105, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly followed the victim before stopping the vehicle. A motorcycle was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: highway robbery, roadside, mobile number, night, suspect, industrial area, motorcycle, witness
